message:
The other day, I found myself digging through the back of the pantry, looking for something—anything—that might pass for a meal during a minor storm. I unearthed a can of green beans and half a box of macaroni that had probably seen better days. As I stood there, contemplating my culinary choices, I realized that I really should have stocked up a bit better. 

It’s funny how a little storm can turn a calm day into a scavenger hunt for food. So, I made a mental note to keep a few extra snacks on hand next time. At least I won’t have to face a dinner of ‘mystery leftovers’ again! 

What’s your favorite tip for being a bit more prepared during stormy weather?
